root_cause.text: The `hci_adv_bcast_annoucement` function in `net/bluetooth/hci_sync.c` fails to validate whether the combined size of the prepended Broadcast Announcement service data and the existing advertising payload exceeds the capacity of the temporary buffer `ad` before copying.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check `if (adv->adv_data_len > sizeof(ad) - len)` to reject the operation and return `-EINVAL` before executing `memcpy(ad + len, adv->adv_data, adv->adv_data_len)`, which prevents a buffer overrun on the temporary buffer `ad`.

intent_record.how: Prevents a potential buffer overflow by aborting the operation and returning an error code if the source data is too large for the destination buffer.
